full_prompt_en: A square Baroque realist oil portrait shows a dark-haired, bearded man from the shoulders upward against a nearly black brown ground. His head occupies most of the left and central frame, with thick wavy hair spreading into the upper-left darkness. The face turns slightly toward the right while the eyes meet the viewer from beneath a deeply furrowed brow. Warm ocher light strikes the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, and upper part of the beard, making them emerge abruptly from the surrounding shadow. His mouth is almost concealed by a full dark mustache, and the heavy beard falls over the lower face in loose, finely streaked curls. The nose and lined skin are carefully modeled, with small amber highlights beside deep umber creases. On the lower left, a dark garment catches a few narrow glossy folds, but its shape mostly merges into the background. The right side is left largely empty, a broad vertical field of very dark warm brown with barely visible brush modulation. This negative space makes the illuminated face feel close and weighty while keeping the setting undefined. Light arrives strongly from the upper left, giving the near side of the face a golden glow; the far side of the head, lower beard, and clothing sink into velvety shadow. Edges vary from crisp along the bright brow and nose to nearly lost where hair and dark fabric meet the ground. The oil surface is smooth where flesh turns through light and more broken where hair and garment absorb it. No props or readable text are present. The overall composition concentrates dramatic attention on the man's searching gaze, balancing warm illuminated flesh against a dense, enveloping dark.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形巴洛克写实油画肖像呈现一名深发、浓须男子的肩部以上近景，背景是近乎黑色的深棕。他的头部占据左侧和中央大部分，浓密波浪发融入左上方黑暗。脸略转向右侧，眼睛从深蹙的眉下望向观者。暖赭色光落在额头、鼻梁、颧骨和胡须上部，使它们从周围阴影中突然浮现。嘴几乎被浓密深色髭须遮住，厚重胡须以松散、细线般的卷曲覆盖下半张脸。鼻子和带纹路的肌肤被仔细塑造，深棕皱褶旁有细小琥珀色高光。左下方，一件深色衣服接住几条狭窄的光亮褶线，但整体形状大多融入背景。右侧基本空置，是一大片很深的暖棕竖向色域，只能隐约看到笔触变化。这片负空间使受光面容显得近而有重量，同时让环境保持不明确。强光从左上照来，赋予面部近侧金色亮光；头的远侧、胡须下部和衣料沉入天鹅绒般的阴影。边缘从眉与鼻受光处的清楚线条，逐渐变化为发丝和深衣遇到背景时几乎消失的边界。油画表面在肌肤转入光线处平滑，在吸收光的毛发和衣料处则更碎。没有道具或可读文字。整体构图把戏剧性注意力集中在男子探寻般的目光上，以暖色受光肌肤对照浓厚包围的黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a Baroque realist oil finish organized by concentrated illumination and large velvety shadows. Warm amber, ocher, and muted flesh tones emerge from near-black umber, with very few middle-value colors competing for attention. Fine smooth transitions model the brightest planes, while darker textures break into loose streaks and nearly disappear at their outer edges. A strong upper-side light creates clear relief across raised surfaces and lets recesses remain deep and opaque. Sharp focal contours dissolve rapidly into lost edges, making the lit area appear close against an undefined shallow ground. The composition favors one substantial illuminated mass offset within generous darkness. Its overall effect is grave, intimate, and dramatically restrained.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有巴洛克写实油画完成面，由集中的照明和大片天鹅绒般的阴影组织。暖琥珀、赭黄与低调肤色从近黑的深棕中浮现，几乎没有中间亮度色彩争夺注意力。细腻平滑的过渡塑造最亮的平面，较暗肌理则化为松散笔线，在外缘几乎消失。强烈的上侧方光在凸起表面形成清楚起伏，让凹处保持深沉不透。清脆焦点轮廓很快融入消失边，使受光区域贴近不明确的浅空间背景。构图让一片有分量的受光形体偏置于充足黑暗中。整体效果严肃、亲近，戏剧性却保持克制。
theme_en: A dark-haired bearded man emerging from a nearly black background
theme_zh: 从近黑背景中浮现的黑发胡须男子
name: Valentin de Boulogne
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
